title: Guardian Overseer Report 2026-04-10
markdown:
# Guardian Category Overseer Report
**Generated:** 2026-04-10 13:01 UTC

## Summary

Partially functional. 3/5 jobs healthy. Two persistent coverage gaps and two stuck jobs flagged but unresolved.

## Critical Issues

### 1. degradation-digest — Never Run (Permanent Gate Failure)
272 all-time gate skips, 0 actual runs. Gate requires non-empty `.instar/state/degradation-events.json` — file exists but contains `[]`. Gate permanently fails. Degradation pattern analysis is completely bypassed.

### 2. ci-monitor — Stuck Failed (43h)
Last run 2026-04-08 22:00, result: failure. guardian-pulse flagged this at 07:00 today. Still unresolved 6h later. Root cause: scheduler rescheduling bug — failed jobs do not advance `nextScheduled`.

### 3. overseer-learning — 3 Days Behind Schedule
Last ran 2026-04-07 10:00. Scheduled slot 2026-04-09 10:00 passed without execution. Same rescheduling bug.

## Notable Findings

**guardian-pulse gate skips:** 266 all-time skips with no gate configured. Caused by maxParallelJobs=2 throttling during busy periods — misleading label, not a real problem. Clears after contention resolves.

**session-continuity-check timeout:** One isolated 145s timeout on 2026-04-10 07:03. Before/after runs normal. Monitor only.

**Handoff API broken:** `/jobs/{slug}/handoff` returns empty for all jobs. State files exist on disk (e.g. `job-handoff-guardian-pulse.md`) but are not served by API. Cross-job data sharing is blind.

**Findings not escalated:** guardian-pulse detected the scheduler bug + 2 stuck jobs at 07:00. 6 hours later, nothing fixed. No escalation path from monitoring findings to human attention.

## Recommendations

1. Fix degradation-digest gate: check file existence only, not content
2. Fix scheduler rescheduling bug in instar source (nextScheduled not advancing on failure)
3. Fix handoff API to read from state directory files
4. Add escalation: guardian-pulse DEGRADED state should trigger attention item or Telegram
